maya: Quick design pass on Compliance > Data settings. A few micro nits: the encryption badge copy, keyboard order, and audit log phrasing.
sam: ok share screenshots or copy, I can patch when back from meetings.
maya: badge currently: 'Encrypted (KMS)'. Tooltip: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls in the docs.' Too long for a badge and wraps weird on mobile.
rija: SR note: parentheses + acronym can be confusing when read aloud. Prefer explicit phrasing that reads naturally, e.g. 'Encryption: customer-managed key'. Keep 'KMS' in docs only.
ada: Accessibility: measured badge text contrast ~2.8:1 on our green — fails WCAG AA for normal text. Options: darken bg or use dark text on light bg with 1px outline. Also badge isn't keyboard-focusable atm.
alyssa: also the badge is a <span>. Screen reader won't announce it on focus. We should make it a button or add role/aria attributes. Example: button with aria-describedby pointing to tooltip content.
maya: Proposed compact badge text: 'Encrypted — customer key'. Tooltip short: 'Encrypted with customer-managed KMS. Only users with key access can decrypt. See docs.' short and actionable.
sam: fine with that. Implementation: badge => <button class="badge" aria-describedby="kms-tooltip-193456">Encrypted — customer key</button>. Tooltip content in a div#kms-tooltip-193456 and show as bottom sheet on mobile.
rija: For SRs, aria-label should be explicit: 'Encryption: customer-managed key. Press enter for details'. That way assistive tech knows it's interactive.
maya: Another issue from keyboard audit: visual order is Region then Retention, but DOM order is reversed. Tab flow lands on retention first, confusing keyboard users.
alyssa: repro: staging, tab through Data settings, hits retention number input then region select. Expected visual/tab order: region -> retention. This breaks form flow and tests.
ada: Retention UI also shows numeric value only (e.g., '90') in field, without unit. Audit logs read 'Retention set to 90' which was ambiguous to compliance reviewers.
maya: Recommendation: show unit inline (e.g., '90 days') and ensure audit log messages are explicit: 'Retention set to 90 days'. Also add optional 'reason' free text when admins change retention; include it in audit export.
sam: I'll reorder DOM elements to match visual layout, add aria-describedby where needed, and change retention input to include unit suffix. Also will change badge color from #008a56 to #006644 to hit 4.5:1 contrast.
rija: color looks better. Also confirm focus styles are 3px visible ring for keyboard nav (consistency with system tokens).
maya: Mobile behavior: convert hover-only tooltip to tap-triggered bottom sheet. Contents should be same short tooltip and a link to the docs. Use id kms-tooltip-193456 for refs.
alyssa: I'll add e2e tests: keyboard order, SR announcement for badge, retention shows units, and audit log wording includes 'days' and optional reason field.
sam: plan: small UI patch today -> PR -> staging deploy. Will include screenshots and accessibility checklist.
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled by @sam at 1934567903 :rocket:
maya: thanks, I'll review the PR once deployed and run the keyboard walkthrough. :thumbsup:
